definitions: Jargon or language derived from psychotherapy and mental health discourse, often used in everyday conversation, sometimes to an extent that it is perceived as overused, misused, or pretentious.
The use of terms and concepts from therapy in casual settings, sometimes simplifying or misapplying their original clinical meaning.
examples: The article criticized the prevalence of therapy-speak in online dating profiles.
She found his constant use of therapy-speak to be a bit much.
Many people are tired of hearing therapy-speak in every discussion.
